```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof pf_view = Inputs.radio(new Map(pf_S.views), { value: "cross", label: t("view") })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
pf_investable = pf_data ? pf_data.cross_model.models.filter((m) => m.status === "OK") : []
viewof pf_chosen = Inputs.checkbox(pf_investable.map((m) => m.id), {
  label: t("models"), value: this?.value ?? ["ipca", "qz_ipca", "naipca_iab"],
  format: (id) => pf_label(id), disabled: pf_view !== "cross"
})
viewof pf_cost = Inputs.radio([0, 10, 50], { label: t("cost"), value: this?.value ?? 0, format: (x) => LANG === "zh" ? `${x} 个基点` : `${x} bp`, disabled: pf_view === "ablation" })
viewof pf_universe = Inputs.radio(pf_data ? pf_data.iab.universes : ["CORE"], { label: t("universe"), value: this?.value ?? "CORE", format: (u) => pf_S.universes[u] ?? u, disabled: pf_view !== "iab" })
viewof pf_logScale = Inputs.toggle({ label: t("log"), value: this?.value ?? true, disabled: pf_view === "ablation" })
viewof pf_sample = Inputs.radio([618, 594], { label: t("sample"), value: this?.value ?? 594, disabled: pf_view !== "ablation" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
pf_months = pf_data ? pf_data.months.map(parseMonth) : []
pf_series = {
  if (!pf_data) return []
  if (pf_view === "cross") {
    return pf_chosen.map((id) => ({ id, label: pf_label(id),
      r: netSeries(pf_data.cross_model.r[id], pf_data.cross_model.turnover[id], pf_cost) }))
  }
  if (pf_view === "iab") {
    return ["beta_only", "complete"].map((leg) => ({ id: leg, label: pf_S.legs[leg],
      r: netSeries(pf_data.iab.r[pf_universe][leg], pf_data.iab.turnover[pf_universe][leg], pf_cost) }))
  }
  return []
}
pf_rows = pf_series.flatMap((s) => wealthPath(s.r).map((w, i) => ({ date: pf_months[i], wealth: w, label: s.label, id: s.id })))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
pf_ablationNames = pf_S.ablation
pf_ablationOrder = ["intercept_off", "mean_only", "complete_iab"]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
pf_chart = {
  if (!pf_data) return html``
  if (pf_view === "cross" && pf_chosen.length === 0) return html`<p class="note">${pf_S.selectOne}</p>`
  if (pf_view === "ablation") {
    const data = pf_data.ablation.filter((d) => d.sample_months === pf_sample)
    return Plot.plot({
      height: 260, marginLeft: 50, style: { fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: 12 },
      ariaLabel: pf_S.ariaAbl,
      ariaDescription: pf_S.ariaAblDesc,
      x: { domain: pf_ablationOrder, tickFormat: (d) => pf_ablationNames[d], label: null },
      y: { label: pf_S.sharpeGross, grid: true },
      marks: [
        Plot.barY(data, { x: "model", y: "gross_sharpe", fill: (d) => d.model === "complete_iab" ? palette.complete : palette.rp_pca }),
        Plot.text(data, { x: "model", y: "gross_sharpe", text: (d) => fmt2(d.gross_sharpe), dy: -8, fontFamily: "inherit" }),
        Plot.ruleY([0])
      ]
    })
  }
  const color = { domain: pf_series.map((s) => s.label), range: pf_series.map((s) => palette[s.id]) }
  return Plot.plot({
    height: 360, marginLeft: 52, style: { fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: 12 },
    ariaLabel: pf_S.ariaCross,
    ariaDescription: pf_S.ariaCrossDesc,
    x: { label: null }, y: { type: pf_logScale ? "log" : "linear", grid: true, label: pf_S.wealth(pf_cost) },
    color: { ...color, legend: true },
    marks: [
      nberMarks(pf_data.nber),
      Plot.lineY(pf_rows, { x: "date", y: "wealth", stroke: "label", strokeWidth: (d) => d.id === "naipca_iab" || d.id === "complete" ? 2 : 1.4 }),
      Plot.tip(pf_rows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "date", y: "wealth", stroke: "label", title: (d) => `${d.label}\n${d.date.toISOString().slice(0, 7)} · ${pf_S.wealthWord} ${fmt2(d.wealth)}` }))
    ]
  })
}
```

//| echo: false
pf_table = {
  if (!pf_data) return html``
  const S = pf_S
  if (pf_view === "cross") {
    if (pf_chosen.length === 0) return html`<p class="note">${S.selectOne}</p>`
    const t = pf_data.cross_model.table.filter((d) => pf_chosen.includes(d.id))
    return html`<table><thead><tr><th>${S.thModel}</th><th>${S.thGross}</th><th>${S.thProxy(pf_cost)}</th><th>${S.thRet}</th><th>${S.thVol}</th><th>${S.thDD}</th><th>${S.thTO}</th><th>${S.thBE}</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>${t.map((d) => { const r = pf_data.cross_model.r[d.id], to = pf_data.cross_model.turnover[d.id]; const net = sharpe(netSeries(r, to, pf_cost));
        return html`<tr><td>${pf_label(d.id)}</td><td>${fmt2(d.gross_sharpe)}</td><td>${fmt2(net)}</td><td>${fmt1(d.annual_return_pct)}</td><td>${fmt1(d.annual_vol_pct)}</td><td>${fmt1(d.max_drawdown_pct)}</td><td>${fmt2(d.turnover)}</td><td>${fmtBp(d.break_even_cost_bp)}</td></tr>` })}</tbody></table>
      <p class="note">${S.pcaNote}</p>`
  }
  if (pf_view === "iab") {
    const t = pf_data.iab.table.filter((d) => d.universe === pf_universe)
    const p = pf_data.iab.paired.filter((d) => d.universe === pf_universe)
    return html`<table><thead><tr><th>${S.thRule}</th><th>${S.thGross}</th><th>${S.thProxy(10)}</th><th>${S.thProxy(50)}</th><th>${S.thRet}</th><th>${S.thDD}</th><th>${S.thTO}</th><th>${S.thBE}</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>${t.map((d) => html`<tr><td>${S.legs[d.leg] ?? d.label}</td><td>${fmt2(d.gross_sharpe)}</td><td>${fmt2(d.net_sharpe_10bp)}</td><td>${fmt2(d.net_sharpe_50bp)}</td><td>${fmt1(d.annual_return_pct)}</td><td>${fmt1(d.max_drawdown_pct)}</td><td>${fmt2(d.turnover)}</td><td>${fmtBp(d.break_even_cost_bp)}</td></tr>`)}</tbody></table>
      <table><thead><tr><th>${S.thPaired}</th><th>${S.thMonths}</th><th>${S.thDiff}</th><th>${S.thCI}</th><th>${S.thHolm}</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>${p.map((d) => html`<tr><td>${d.sample === "STRICT24_FULL" ? S.full : S.recent}</td><td>${d.n_months}</td><td>${(d.mean_diff_monthly * 100).toFixed(2)}%</td><td>[${(d.ci_low * 100).toFixed(2)}%, ${(d.ci_high * 100).toFixed(2)}%]</td><td>${d.p_holm < 1e-4 ? "< 0.0001" : d.p_holm.toFixed(4)}</td></tr>`)}</tbody></table>
      <p class="note">${S.iabNote}</p>`
  }
  const d = pf_data.ablation.filter((x) => x.sample_months === pf_sample)
  return html`<table><thead><tr><th>${S.thInput}</th><th>${S.thGross}</th><th>${S.thRet}</th><th>${S.thVol}</th><th>${S.thDD}</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>${d.map((x) => html`<tr><td>${pf_ablationNames[x.model]}</td><td>${fmt2(x.gross_sharpe)}</td><td>${fmt1(x.annual_return_pct)}</td><td>${fmt1(x.annual_vol_pct)}</td><td>${fmt1(x.max_drawdown_pct)}</td></tr>`)}</tbody></table>
    <p class="note">${S.ablNote}</p>`
}
